scenario_description: Elena has started driving two classroom-material bins from Indianola K-8 School to Dominion Middle School for an afternoon assignment when her sedan loses power and will not restart. She is stranded with the bins in a library parking lot, so the active transfer cannot continue. A stored district procedure allows a materials courier to retrieve school property from a disabled vehicle, but using it requires connecting Elena's location, the destination, the number of bins, and the dispatch contact. The need is sufficiently observable when Elena reports the breakdown in event3; later events establish the delivery deadline and confirm that roadside assistance cannot restore her trip in time.

parameter.subject: Updated February 6 assignment: midday material transfer
parameter.body: After your morning coverage at Indianola K-8 School, please take the two labeled science-material bins from the main office to Maya Chen at Dominion Middle School. Then report to Room 214 for your afternoon coverage. Maya expects you and the bins around 12:20 PM.

parameter.content: I have both science bins in my car and just pulled away from Indianola. I should reach Dominion around 12:15.
My car lost power on North Broadway and will not restart. I made it safely into the parking lot at the Whetstone library, near the main entrance. I am stranded here with both science bins.
The students can begin without the bins, but we need them at Dominion by 12:35 for the hands-on part of the lesson. I am supervising the class and cannot leave campus to collect them.

parameter.subject: Roadside request confirmed: Whetstone library
parameter.body: Your roadside request has been accepted for the Whetstone library parking lot. Current arrival estimate is 1:00 PM to 1:20 PM. The responding driver will assess the vehicle before determining whether it can be restarted or must be towed.
